_first_run: First run (2026-09-28, labels committed in 738ff1d before it): 20/21 detected, 1 missed, 0 false alarms, 11/13 secure confirmed. The miss was a parser bug, fixed afterwards (a '! text' comment inside an ACL ended the ACL); the table below is after that fix.
newyork.cfg BOUNDARY-001: first run: missed. ACL AS1_TO_AS2 has '! deny …' comment lines before its 'permit ip any any' (line 138); the IOS parser treated a comment as the end of the ACL and never saw the permit. Fixed in the parser, regression test in test_cisco_acl.py
SecurityGroups.json BOUNDARY-001: undecided, correctly: the default groups' all-protocol rules admit only their own group (UserIdGroupPairs), which no seed reads, so no verdict is claimed
